Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Class FaceSearchSessionConfig

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.search.FaceSearchSessionConfig
public final class FaceSearchSessionConfig extends java.lang.Object
Immutable continuous face-search settings. Does not configure camera resolution, exposure, or capture frame rate. Null and empty group/tag values both mean no restriction; the filters are combined with AND. Neither mode checks head pose. Single-face mode enables single-frame liveness by default; multi-face mode does not run liveness. Both require a face of at least 100 x 100 pixels.
